verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the software-editing acceptance range of 30–90 seconds for short-form clips.
First concrete failure: the client reports that a reviewed clip was shorter than the required duration range.
The client changes the rendered clip-duration acceptance range from 30–90 seconds to 45–60 seconds; overwriting the existing bounds requires no attribute removal.
Distinct post-change failure: the client's review identifies clips being made at 30 seconds instead of the established 45–60-second target.
The client adds a concrete approval condition that clips shorter than 45 seconds will not be accepted; it is consistent with the existing duration bounds and leaves no obsolete key.
The newly authorized shorter clip styles materially conflict with the existing 45-second approval floor without specifying a replacement duration boundary.
